findings.issue: The pt-BR gloss in the prompt mistranslates the target sentence. 年月が経つのは早いね means 'como o tempo passa rápido, né?' (the body translates it exactly that way), not 'faz tempo, não?', which in pt-BR means 'it's been a while'. Sense-changing error in the very sentence the learner must complete.
findings.current: Escolha o conector: 'A propósito, faz tempo, não?' ＿＿、年月が経つのは早いね。
findings.suggested: Escolha o conector: 'A propósito, o tempo passa rápido, né?' ＿＿、年月が経つのは早いね。

findings.issue: 'partilham' is Portugal-leaning usage in this sense; pt-BR standard for 'share a kanji' is 'compartilham'.
findings.current: Cuidado com o par 責任 e 責める, que partilham o kanji 責.
findings.suggested: Cuidado com o par 責任 e 責める, que compartilham o kanji 責.

findings.issue: Tense clash in the code-mixed sentence: the Portuguese frame 'acaba sendo ... por todos' is habitual/present, but 責められた is the past passive ('foi culpado'). The form modeled to the learner does not fit the sentence.
findings.current: Quem foge da 責任 acaba sendo 責められた por todos.
findings.suggested: Quem foge da 責任 acaba sendo culpado (責められる) por todos.

findings.issue: Stilted, near-tautological Japanese: 特徴は独特だ ('the characteristic is peculiar') plus the odd collocation 読書の特徴. Grammatical but not what a native would write; the pt-BR gloss ('O jeito dele de ler') already points to 読書の仕方. Reading attribute would need updating with the fix.
findings.current: <jp reading="かれのどくしょのとくちょうはどくとくだ">彼の読書の特徴は独特だ</jp>
findings.suggested: <jp reading="かれのどくしょのしかたはどくとくだ">彼の読書の仕方は独特だ</jp>

findings.issue: Wrong pt-BR gloss of 年月が経つのは早いね: 'faz tempo' means 'it's been a while', not 'time passes quickly'. The body translates the very same sentence correctly ('como o tempo passa rápido, não?'), so the exercise contradicts the lesson.
findings.current: Escolha o conector: 'A propósito, faz tempo, não?' ＿＿、年月が経つのは早いね。
findings.suggested: Escolha o conector: 'A propósito, como o tempo passa rápido, não?' ＿＿、年月が経つのは早いね。

findings.issue: 彼の読書の特徴は独特だ is unnatural Japanese: 読書の特徴 is odd collocation and 特徴は独特だ is circular ('the distinguishing feature is distinctive'). It also does not match the gloss 'o jeito dele de ler'.
findings.current: <jp reading="かれのどくしょのとくちょうはどくとくだ">彼の読書の特徴は独特だ</jp>
findings.suggested: <jp reading="かれのどくしょのしかたはどくとくだ">彼の読書の仕方は独特だ</jp>

findings.issue: Leftover authoring instruction inside learner-facing prose: 'Use a gramática deste tópico ... nos seus exemplos' addresses the content author, not the student (paired with 'Este lote', also authoring jargon).
findings.current: Use a gramática deste tópico, como ～ことにしている (faço questão de) e ～つもりでした (eu pretendia), nos seus exemplos.
findings.suggested: Nos exemplos reaparece a gramática deste tópico: ～ことにしている (faço questão de) e ～つもりでした (eu pretendia).

findings.issue: Tense mismatch in the mixed pt-BR/JP sentence of the l1-pitfall note: 'acaba sendo' requires the non-past passive 責められる; 責められた is past and does not fit the construction.
findings.current: Quem foge da 責任 acaba sendo 責められた por todos.
findings.suggested: Quem foge da 責任 acaba sendo 責められる por todos.
